scientific_assumptions.frame: one local normal orthonormal frame for all signed number, energy and tensor sources
scientific_assumptions.thermal_gas: isotropic nonrelativistic monatomic common-T bath; pi_th=0
scientific_assumptions.fast_tensor: separate from thermal gas and from collisionless DM

parent.reuse: Read source/theory/mass transcription; no parent function invocation and no completed-identity replay.

inputs.reaction_id: one predefined PHYS81 bare-nucleus ground-state channel
inputs.beta_normal_vector: finite 3-vector, norm<1; exact pair CM velocity/c relative to normal frame
inputs.photon_direction_com: finite unit 3-vector in same spatial tetrad with declared orientation
inputs.ownership: literal FAST_FIRST or separately requested PROMPT_THERMAL; no implicit zeta->number mapping

invariants: energy sum zero before numerical roundoff
baryon and charge preserved over thermal+fast pools
numeric_guidance: Reuse parent's factored COM energy split rather than subtracting squared masses.
For near-zero daughter kinetic energy, evaluate c^2 p^2/(epsilon+mc^2) from boosted momentum.
Do not force residual to zero or use closure remainder as an independent reference.

weighted_average.input: nonnegative finite event-rate weights and normal-frame event records from a single declared physical sampling measure
weighted_average.normalization: R=sum(weights); when R>0 use the same weights/R for every number and energy component
weighted_average.zero_rate: all sources zero; conditional event means null/undefined
weighted_average.angular_zero_condition: D=0 only with a stated conditional angular symmetry, or independently justified isotropic equal-T CM/relative distribution and V-independent rotationally covariant emission kernel.
weighted_average.precision_rule: Evaluate stable event quantities where A-C^2 B cancellation matters; preserve sampled quadrature residual without continuum certification.

source_assembly.thermal_number: S_nth=-2 sum_r R_r + sum_c J_c plus independently admitted other thermal number sources
source_assembly.fast_number: S_nfast,c=R_into_c-J_c plus admitted other population sources
source_assembly.temperature: (3/2)n_th kB Tdot= -n_th kB T Theta + Q_th -(3/2)kB T S_nth
source_assembly.collisionless_frame: Rest/kinetic split is an energy ledger; fast stress must be derived from its distribution in the same normal frame.

assumptions: sigma(E) channel-specific with no explicit T dependence for derivative identity
differentiation under the rate integral is justified
maxwellian_reduction.separation: These NR Maxwellian formulas do not by themselves supply an exact relativistic event measure or the normal-frame outgoing moments B,D.
maxwellian_reduction.exact_event_vs_nr_measure: Keep separate approximation tags. No unspecified mixture is admitted.
maxwellian_reduction.molar_rates: A provider returning N_A<sigma v> must be divided by N_A before use with number densities.

source_references.used_for: boost and exact two-body kinematics; restored c and (-+++) convention

source_references.title: The TDF System for Thermonuclear Plasma Reaction Rates, Mean Energies and Two-Body Final State Particle Spectra
source_references.author: Stephen I. Warshaw
source_references.used_for: reaction-selected averages, CM/relative separation and derivative relation; massive-final-state NR partition not adopted for photon
channel cross-section Maxwellian rate convention, with N_A units explicitly distinguished

verification.method: actual Wolfram Language symbolic algebra; independent direct energy/four-vector derivation
verification.scope: symbolic identities under declared assumptions; no nuclear empirical-rate integration or cosmological run

next_acceptance_tests: Exact energy and momentum conservation from supplied on-shell incoming pair and emitted direction, using independent mass-shell check.
Cold E*=0, beta=0 recovers parent stored cold energies by data reuse; do not rerun completed parent suite.
FAST_FIRST and PROMPT_THERMAL counts separately satisfy A/Z stoichiometry and are mutually exclusive.
Assimilation transfers actual residual energy and one particle from fast to thermal exactly once.
Supplied positive event weights preserve all linear ledgers; zero-rate output uses null conditional means.
Synthetic sigma(E)=sigma0 E^s, s>-2 gives Gamma(s+2) rate and <E>=(s+2)kBT.
Synthetic sigma*v constant leaves T unchanged in fast-first removal; constant sigma gives -T R/(3 n_th).
Refuse nonfinite or negative weights, malformed directions, beta>=1 and mixed energy/frame/source tags.
remaining_obligations: channel-specific total/differential nuclear source with supported low-energy domain
finite-T physical event measure, angular kernel and controlled nonrelativistic/relativistic interface
fast-product stopping and thermal matching provider
common mass covariance and physical uncertainty
production adapter implementation and independent runtime verification

claims.statement: Same-normal-frame exact two-body event ledger closes with incoming kinetic debit.
Exclusive fast-first population has delta N_th=-2 and delta N_fast=+1; later assimilation supplies number transfer.
A supplied nonnegative event measure maps to scalar sources through A,B,D without losing linear energy conservation.
For specified equal-T NR Maxwellian assumptions, selected incoming kinetic mean is kB*T*(3+dlnK/dlnT).

strong_no_go.reason: Constructive source/ownership contract; no impossibility or exclusion claim.
